_comment: Single source of truth for harness detection and hook output shape. Read by hooks/emit-context (bash, via line-oriented sed) and hooks/ponytail-runtime.js (node, via require). Keep one harness per line: emit-context parses this file without jq, because jq is not a safe dependency inside a session-start hook. Order matters — the first harness whose detect var is set wins, so cursor precedes claude (Cursor may also set CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT).
